native_controls.scope: Original sampling functions with NumPy and bounded independent combinations/product oracles. No huge integers, fallback replacement statistics or full training package qualification.

findings: Finite square and rectangular pair samplers match independent combinations/product oracles; sampled subset checks include uniqueness and bounds.
Canonical representative selects each field independently and resolves centroid ties using first minimum; representative need not be an existing whole record.
Training helper treats same common_key as matching, all other sampled pairs as distinct; labels inherit this input assumption.
